question: Do the public eFOI search-listing entries for the 2023 Marikina River fish-information request expose response contents or biological data from NFRDI or PCAARRD?

sourceAccess.accessMethod: The official search-index result exposed entries for the request on 2026-11-24 and reported that the listing had been crawled approximately six months earlier. Direct opens of the listing and agency pages returned robots or HTTP 503 errors. No login, message, new request, or access workaround was used.
sourceAccess.sourceScope: A 2 May 2023 public request titled ‘Fish Species in Marikina River’ appears under multiple agencies. This review checks only the visible NFRDI and PCAARRD disposition labels.

agencyStatuses.agency: National Fisheries Research and Development Institute (NFRDI)
Philippine Council for Agriculture, Aquatic and Natural Resources Research and Development (PCAARRD)

evidenceDecision.decision: Retain these portal statuses as research-access metadata only. No underlying answer or biological data is available in the reviewed listing excerpt.

limitations: DENIED and CLOSED are status labels; the listing does not supply the reason for either agency disposition.
The status labels do not establish whether the agencies maintain fish-survey, occurrence, or other relevant datasets.
The index excerpt is approximately six months old and may not reflect later page changes.
The direct response pages and attachments were not retrieved; no access control or portal challenge was bypassed.
This listing does not establish fish presence or absence, a complete Marikina checklist, fishing access, legality, or safety.
nextAction: Do not spend further effort treating these request-status listings as data. Continue with independent published fish studies, repository or sequence records, and occurrence databases; revisit agency responses only if the response text or attachment becomes ordinarily accessible.

sources.supports: Official eFOI search-result excerpt showing the NFRDI request entry marked DENIED and PCAARRD request entry marked CLOSED; it does not expose response reasons or biological data.
Identifies the corresponding NFRDI public response-page URL; page content was not retrieved.
Identifies the corresponding PCAARRD public response-page URL; page content was not retrieved.
